DRNSBase::decompose_array launches gridDimGlb = poly_degree * size() / blockDimGlb.x and passes dst, gpu_ckks_msg_vec_->in(), base(), poly_degree to this kernel; this small-domain override fixes size()==1 and poly_degree=128 so native launch is grid=1, blockDimGlb.x=128.
blockDimGlb is the native physical block size 128 used by DRNSBase::decompose_array.

PhantomCKKSEncoder::encode_internal passes coeff_count as poly_degree and gpu_ckks_msg_vec_->in() as src; constructor sets slots_=coeff_count>>1, so the source allocation is slots_ cuDoubleComplex values.

DCKKSEncoderInfo allocates in_ with slots=coeff_count>>1 cuDoubleComplex elements. Therefore for poly_degree=128 the call-site source buffer is 64*16=1024 bytes, captured as expression poly_degree*8 <= src.payload_len.

DRNSTool::moddown_from_NTT launches this alpha==1 branch with gridDimGlb = n * size_Ql / blockDimGlb.x and passes delta.get(), cx_i + size_Ql_n, n, base_QlP_.base(), size_QlP.
delta is allocated as size_Ql*n uint64_t elements; the small-domain override fixes n=128 and size_QlP=2 with alpha==size_P_=1, so size_Ql=size_QlP-1=1 and dst is 128*8=1024 bytes.
The key-switch call path allocates cx as 2*size_QlP*n uint64_t values and passes cx_i into moddown_from_NTT; cx_i + size_Ql_n addresses the P component, which is n uint64_t values when alpha==1.
blockDimGlb is 128, so n=128 and size_Ql=1 make the native launch grid=1 with blockDimGlb.x=128.
